tokens._scope: pinned to the #qa-probe rig — the full fan-out turn markup rendered by the page's own code. The visible copy is byte-identical markup under the same CSS, and real session panes are excluded because their transcript content differs per machine and per run

contrast._pair: tool-row primary text: --ink on --inset (.trow background); pinned to the probe rig for run-to-run determinism
step-log first line on --card (every .gv-ln carries a state class, so this measures the palette's log colours on the .pane, the nearest painted ancestor)
